propositions: Extract build_model_settings() and build_usage_limits() from runner.py into structured_run.py as pure functions with explicit parameters without side effects
build_model_settings must not mutate _TEMPERATURE_WITHDRAWN_LOGGED; that mutation remains inline in run() beside the set it mutates
build_usage_limits must return tuple[UsageLimits, int, int] with req_limit and eff_max_iter as separate unpacked locals since eff_max_iter cannot be recovered from the returned UsageLimits object
cache_settings must be an input parameter to build_model_settings, not recomputed, to preserve the model_override guard and prevent silent re-enabling of cache settings on offline TestModel path
structured_run.py must remain under 500 LOC and runner.py must be reduced under 700 LOC with the measurement recorded greppably in the commit message
